title: What Data Art Biennales Is
definition: Data Art Biennales: biennales of art made from data.
description:
Strip Data Art Biennales to its essence and you get biennales of art made from data. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Art, Design & Fashion: first data pipelines understanding, then biennale logistics prototypes, then dataset ethics operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of biennale hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Data Art Biennales
title: Real Research Today: Data Art Biennales
definition: Today's documented research behind Data Art Biennales.
description:
The road to Data Art Biennales is already being paved. Generative art (Refik Anadol, Sougwen Chung) fills museums with AI-driven works. Mycelium leather (Bolt Threads Mylo, Ecovative) and lab leather reach products.

Digital fashion (DressX, The Fabricant) sells clothes that exist only on avatars. Together these programs form the data pipelines foundation that Data Art Biennales will build on — the biennale logistics results, the dataset ethics methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as biennale logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Data Art Biennales
definition: Estimates Data Art Biennales readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Data Art Biennales components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a biennale hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Data Art Biennales Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Data Art Biennales: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Data Art Biennales — biennales of art made from data.

Phase 1 — Prove (data pipelines): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (biennale logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (dataset ethics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (visualization craft): biennale hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and art-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
